title: Sierpi\'nski--Knopp Wasserstein Distance for Persistence Diagrams and Applications to 2-Wasserstein Approximation
abstract: arXiv:2609.01528v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper introduces the Sierpi\'nski-Knopp (SK) Wasserstein distance, a fast metric between persistence diagrams. The SK-Wasserstein distance, denoted $d_{\mathrm{SK}}$, maps diagram points and their diagonal projections to the unit interval via the Sierpi\'nski-Knopp space-filling curve on the upper diagonal triangle. The encoded point sets are then efficiently matched via one-dimensional optimal assignment, in \(O(N\log N)\) steps, yielding an explicit diagonal-aware point assignment between the two input persistence diagrams. We show that the SK-Wasserstein distance controls the classical \(2\)-Wasserstein distance between diagrams, admits an explicit isometric embedding into a Hilbert space, and induces a positive-definite Gaussian kernel, making the resulting geometry directly compatible with Euclidean and kernel-based learning methods. translated_title: 持久图上的谢尔宾斯基–克诺普 Wasserstein 距离及其在 2-Wasserstein 近似中的应用
translated_abstract: 本文提出了谢尔宾斯基–克诺普Wasserstein 距离，这是一种用于持久图之间的快速度量。记为 $d_{\mathrm{SK}}$ 的 SK-Wasserstein 距离，通过定义在上对角三角形上的谢尔宾斯基–克诺普空间填充曲线，将持久图中的点及其在对角线上的投影映射到单位区间。随后，编码后的点集通过一维最优分配以 $O(N\log N)$ 的复杂度高效匹配，从而在两个输入持久图之间产生显式的、感知对角线的点分配。我们证明 SK-Wasserstein 距离能够控制持久图之间的经典 2-Wasserstein 距离，可显式等距嵌入到希尔伯特空间中，并诱导出一个正定的高斯核，使得所得到的几何结构可直接与欧几里得方法及基于核的学习方法兼容。本文还基于点……引入了一个更紧的替代不相似度，记为 $W_\Gamma$。
tldr: 本文提出谢尔宾斯基–克诺普 Wasserstein 距离，借助空间填充曲线和一维最优匹配以 O(N log N) 复杂度快速度量持久图，该距离可控制经典 2-Wasserstein 距离、支持等距希尔伯特嵌入并诱导正定高斯核，从而可直接兼容欧氏与核方法学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Sierpiński–Knopp Wasserstein distance, a fast metric for persistence diagrams that uses a space-filling curve and one-dimensional optimal assignment in O(N log N) time, controls the classical 2-Wasserstein distance, and admits an isometric Hilbert-space embedding with a positive-definite Gaussian kernel, making it directly compatible with Euclidean and kernel-based learning methods.
